_readme: Where words and stickers may sit on the 9:16 frame. Every text layer (captions, hook, card, screen, end card, lower third, platform UI, icons, disclaimers) names a ZONE here — never a raw height. Every zone is a box in % of the frame, measured from the top-left (x, y = its top-left corner; w, h = its size). Each one sits inside the content 4:5 zone (the 22 Sep rule: 9:16 frame, the content in the centred 4:5 band = 14.8%–85.2% down) AND clear of every platform's own buttons in machine/defaults.json → safe_zones.surfaces (the right-hand icon rail, the bottom caption/CTA band, the top bar). Centred zones keep the same margin both sides as the right rail so centred words look centred. The gate refuses a zone id that is not here and a zone that crosses a surface's buttons. FACE-AWARE: when production marks where the person is (`subject_box` per scene in plan.json), a layer whose zone covers the face moves to the nearest free zone in its `moves_to` list and the cut sheet records why; with no subject box the gate WARNS that placement is face-blind for that scene. Two layers on screen at the same moment never hold zones that mostly overlap (more than `crowd_overlap` of the smaller one) — the later one moves, in order hook → captions → platform UI → lower thirds → icons. Only the owner signs a row approved.
updated: 2026-09-23 (the owner: headline and captions sat too high; captions belong toward the bottom; organic surfaces)

zones.name: Top headline
zones.what: The first band under the app's top bar, inside the 4:5 content zone.
zones.when_to_use: The hook. It is the first thing read on frame one.

zones.name: Upper third
zones.when_to_use: A comment-reply bubble, a search bar, a second headline line, a sticker that sits above the face.

zones.name: Centre
zones.what: Dead centre of the safe frame.
zones.when_to_use: One-word captions, a stat, a burst sticker — only when nobody's face is there.

zones.name: Centre block
zones.what: The big middle box a plate's words sit in.
zones.when_to_use: A card's lines, a screen (review, comment, DM, site, order, search) and the end card's offer — scenes that are a plate, not a face.

zones.name: Lower third
zones.what: A left-aligned strap above the caption band, clear of the right-hand icons.
zones.when_to_use: A name and title strap (an expert, a customer).

zones.name: Caption band
zones.what: The lowest band words may use — the line just above the app's own caption, handle and CTA button.
zones.when_to_use: Spoken-word captions. Low enough to leave the face alone, high enough that no platform covers it.

zones.name: Fine print
zones.what: A thin strip under the caption band.
zones.when_to_use: Disclaimers only — small, always legible, never covered.

zones.name: Left rail
zones.what: A block on the left, between the upper third and the caption band — the mirror of the platform icon rail, which is always on the right.
zones.when_to_use: A like or view counter, a small icon or emoji, a price tag next to a face.

zones.name: Top left
zones.what: The top-left corner under the top bar.
zones.when_to_use: A 'Stitched with' / 'Duet with' pill, a small badge.

defaults._platform_ui: each platform-UI style names its own zone (looks/platform_ui.json)
